claims.sourceText: OTA, 'A History of the Department of Defense Federally Funded Research and Development Centers', 1995
claims.text: The Office of Technology Assessment's 1995 history records that the Air Force specifically insisted on restrictions in the Aerospace Corporation charter that it had not imposed on earlier FFRDCs.

edges.label: MITRE was created on the RAND model as the Air Force's systems engineering counterpart
edges.note: RAND, incorporated 1948 out of Project RAND, established the permanent contractor-operated analytical partner form; the Air Force replicated it for systems engineering in 1958.

title: OTA - A History of DoD FFRDCs
